description: This file defines the SessionSubscriber class, which subscribes to request events in a Symfony-based web application to manage user sessions, specifically invalidating sessions after a period of inactivity.

classes.name: SessionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for HTTP request events to manage user sessions, invalidating sessions after a configurable idle timeout.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the request event to its handler method and priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event by checking session activity and invalidating the session if it has been idle too long.
